Name: Moveable Farmhouse
Author: sexynes
Description:
[b][size=5]Requirements [/size]
[/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3] Must be a vanilla farm map. [/size]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Recommendations[/size][size=3] [/size]
[/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679]Debug Mode[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/size]
[/list]
[b][size=5]General Instructions [/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679]Debug Mode[/url] to find the XY coordinates of where you want the top left corner of the farmhouse to be relocated (the width of the farmhouse is 9 tiles, and the height of the farmhouse is 6 tiles), and clear the area of debris. You can also type "whereami" into SMAPI if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Enter the farmhouse. [/size]
[*][size=3]Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to enter the XY coordinates of the corresponding farm type, then save and close the config menu. [/size]
[*][size=3]Save the game by sleeping. [/size]
[*][size=3]Once saved, close the game and restart SMAPI. [/size]
[/list][size=3]
[size=5][b]Default Coordinates For All Vanilla Farm Maps [/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]X: 59 [/size]
[*][size=3]Y: 11 [/size]
[/list]
Farm map modders can use the code and template within this mod to apply to their custom farm map; crediting would be appreciated.[/size]

Manifest.Description: Allows the farmhouse to be moved.
